api.batchReported: The batch already has its results
api.blindModel: The model `{model}` cannot see record values
api.modelPinned: Every transform runs on `{model}`, so no other model can be picked
api.resultsMismatch: One result per proposal is required

user.label: User
user.description: The person who asked; only they can continue the turn.

model.label: Model
model.description: The `ai.models` entry the turn plans with.

page.label: Page
page.description: The dashboard path the person asked from.

input.label: Input
input.description: What the person typed, without the fences around it.

skill.label: Skill
skill.description: The skill the turn started with; empty for none.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: The first turn of the chat this one follows up in; empty on that first turn.

flow.label: Flow
flow.description: A flow turn's walk: the flow, the typed message, the node running and the nodes still to run, as JSON.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.description: The conversation as the provider keeps it, as JSON.

batches.label: Batches
batches.description: The requests each step proposed, as JSON.

texts.label: Texts
texts.description: The model's text per step, as JSON.

step.label: Steps
step.description: How many model steps the turn has run.

usage.label: Usage
usage.description: The tokens the turn has spent, as JSON.

closedAt.label: Closed at
closedAt.description: When the turn ended; empty while it is open.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: Why the turn ended; empty while it is open.

autoAccept.label: Auto-accept
autoAccept.description: Let the assistant apply the edits this app allows without asking first. Everything else still waits for your approval.
autoAccept.ownOnly: Only the account's owner can turn this on, in their account settings

dashboard.placeholderStarters: Search, ask, or type / for skills and flows
dashboard.start: Type a question above and press Enter, or / for a skill or a flow
dashboard.followUp: Type a follow-up above and press Enter

reason.timeout: It took too long. Nothing more was changed.
reason.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
reason.network: The connection dropped. Nothing more was changed.
reason.steps: The assistant reached its step limit for one question.
reason.turnGone: This conversation can no longer be continued. Your question starts a new one.
reason.limit: You have reached the assistant's limit for now.
reason.forbidden: You may not use the assistant.
reason.left: The page closed while the assistant was answering.
reason.idle: This waited too long for an answer and closed.
reason.running: Still being answered in another window.
reason.blindModel: This model cannot see record values. Pick another one.
reason.empty: The assistant found nothing to do.

read.list: Read {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection}
read.listFiltered: Read {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection} matching a filter
read.found: Found {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} in {collection} for `{query}`
read.translations: Read the translations of a record of {collection}
read.verdicts: Checked what you may change in {collection}

batch.create: Create {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} in {collection}
batch.update: Update {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection}
batch.delete: Delete {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection}
batch.copyTranslations: Copy translations onto {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection}
batch.deleteTranslations: Delete a translation of {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection}
batch.loadFailed: Could not load the records this change reaches, so it cannot be approved
batch.sent: {count, plural, one {# change sent} other {# changes sent}}
batch.unknown: {count, plural, one {# may have run} other {# may have run}}

transform.header: Rewrite {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} of {collection}
transform.skipped: {count, plural, one {# record skipped} other {# records skipped}}: {reasons}

reason.incomplete: {count} need a field this rewrite leaves out
reason.failed: {count} without an answer from the model

transform.unreached: {count, plural, one {# more record was} other {# more records were}} not reached; ask again for the rest
transform.noModel: No model may see record values, so nothing can be rewritten

page.stayed: Stayed here to keep your unsaved changes
